TurboRama Commercial Installer includes the unmodified 7za.exe command-line
program from 7-Zip 24.09.

7-Zip Copyright (C) 1999-2024 Igor Pavlov.

7za.exe is redistributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version
2.1 or (at your option) any later version, together with the additional license
information that applies to 7-Zip components. See the accompanying files:

  LICENSE-7ZIP-24.09.txt
  COPYING-LGPL-2.1.txt

Official project and corresponding source code:

  https://www.7-zip.org/
  https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/tree/24.09

TurboRama does not modify or statically link 7za.exe. It invokes the separate
program only to create, verify, and extract the commercial installer payload.
